exposure: Circular opening and concentric suturing (COCS) method of cesarean operation
outcome: Comparison of COCS and LSCS methods
Merits and demerits of COCS method
cohort: 60 patients undergoing cesarean section, divided into two groups of 30: one group receiving standard LSCS and the other receiving the COCS method.
finding: The COCS method for cesarean section is feasible, does not delay delivery, and requires less uterine closure time compared to the standard LSCS method.
